banner.title: gpu-node-dashboard
banner.tagline: A Grafana dashboard for the Arc B70 on talos-3: VRAM, power, device slots and chat throughput on one screen.

explainer.title: One JSON file, five sections, no runtime

steps.title: Provision
steps.text: A ConfigMap named gpu-node-dashboard is generated from gpu-node.json and labelled grafana_dashboard. The Grafana sidecar loads it into the AI/ML folder.
steps.scene: a dashboard card sliding into a folder

steps.title: VRAM
steps.text: Used and total VRAM for PCI 0000:03:00.0 from the xe driver metrics, plus the VRAM each pod holds.
steps.scene: a memory module with a fill gauge

steps.title: Power
steps.text: Power draw, temperature and fan speed from the talos-3 hwmon sensors, beside the static power limits.
steps.scene: a heat sensor over a glowing chip

steps.title: Allocation
steps.text: Allocatable and requested slots for devic.es/b70 and gpu.intel.com/xe, and the pods holding a device.
steps.scene: tickets handed out from a counter

steps.title: Throughput
steps.text: Decode and prefill tokens per second for each llama.cpp model and KV type, slots busy and queued, and draft acceptance.
steps.scene: a speed dial over a token stream

art.about: a Grafana dashboard for GPU telemetry
